svg.title: Writing ર
svg.desc: 1 frames; frame N shows movements 1 to N of ર (gujarati), the movement being added drawn in ink over the finished letter, whose outline is read from _fonts/NotoSansGujarati-Static.ttf. Stroke order after t30apps.com, ‘Gujarati Alphabet Writing Practice’, version 1.0, ર animation, first SVG path <https://www.t30apps.com/gujarati-alphabet-writing/>. Source note on variation: The teaching app animates ર as one continuous pen-down run in its first SVG path; its remaining path slots are empty. The run begins at the upper left, circles clockwise around the rounded upper body, narrows through the middle, curls around the small middle loop, then descends diagonally into the lower-right tail without lifting. The app explicitly says that depicted forms and stroke orders can differ by source and should be treated as one variant, not a universal standard. The bundled Noto Sans Gujarati glyph preserves the rounded upper body, narrow middle, small loop, and descending tail, but its printed turns are wider and more angular and its tail broader than the animated school-hand form. This learner path preserves the source's upper-body-to-middle-loop-to-lower-tail order and zero-lift evidence while fitting the continuous run to the font's ink. Individual handwriting may narrow, round, simplify, retrace, or slant the body, loop, tail, and terminals differently.
svg.text: How it is written — one unbroken stroke · 1 movement
